ChildMinutesLst.Title: b. Seal of Biliteracy Award & Resolution
ChildMinutesLst.Minutes:
The Seal of Biliteracy recognizes graduating students who are proficient in English as well as one other language.

Approve the implementation of the Seal of Biliteracy for the Grandview C-4 School District, beginning on March 21, 2025 and adopt the accompanying resolution in support of this initiative.

ChildMinutesLst.Title: a. Grandview 8 & 10 Recommendations for 2025-26
ChildMinutesLst.Minutes:
Recommendations from employee groups, Grandview 8 (for classified staff) and Grandview 10 (for certificated staff) were presented to the Board for consideration of compensation for 2025-26.

Approve the 2025-2026 certificated (teachers), B-Salary, extra duty, all classified, administrators, and central office personnel schedules as presented.

ChildMinutesLst.Title: a. Grandview 8 & 10 Insurance Proposal
ChildMinutesLst.Minutes:
Recommendations from employee groups, Grandview 8 (for classified staff) and Grandview 10 (for certificated staff) were presented to the Board for consideration of employee insurance for 2025-26.

Approve the recommendation of Grandview 8 and Grandview 10 to renew the Blue Cross Blue Shield Health Insurance with a 2.0% increase and Delta Dental, Standard, and New York Life insurance policies at the proposed rates for the 2025-2026 year.

LstItemMinutes.Title: J. Report of Board Members and Agenda Requests
LstItemMinutes.Minutes:
Helen Ransom commented on attending MSBA's Advocacy Day in Jeff City and conversations she had with Representative Ealy, and shared info on upcoming changes to the advanced certifications for Board members provided by MSBA.
Dawn Foy encouraged Board participation at the Distinguished Alumni Brunch which will be held on May 31st at the Armacost Museum.
Monica Terry presented service pins to Stacy Wright and Joshua Hill who've each completed one term (3 years) and to Dawn Foy for completing two terms (6 years) of service on the Board of Education.
